## Conventions

This repo follows the pywf internal proprietary Python library template: closed source, published to a private AWS CodeArtifact repository, never to PyPI. **Before creating or restructuring modules, tests, or docs, load the `pywf-priv-base` skill** and read the reference for the job. `<package_name>` below is the import package directory. The rules below are the ones that are easy to break silently. The skill has the reasons and the details.

- Run everything through mise: `mise run inst` (install), `mise run cov` (tests and coverage), `mise run build-doc` (docs). Use `.venv/bin/python`; never `pip install`.
- `mise run inst` fetches a CodeArtifact token with the AWS profile in `mise.toml`, so no task depends on it: run it after cloning and after every dependency or version change. A bare `uv sync` / `uv lock` / `uv add` fails on the private index; wrap it as in the skill.
- Every private package, transitive ones included, is listed both as a requirement and in `[tool.uv.sources]` with the private index.
- Python 3.11+ only: `X | None`, `list[str]`; never `T.Optional` / `T.List`. `import typing as T` is the only way typing is imported.
- Every `.py` file starts with `# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-` (on line 2, after a shebang if there is one).
- One imported name per statement: `from abc import e` and `from abc import f` on two lines, never `from abc import e, f`.
- Import order in source files: `typing as T`, then stdlib, then third party, then close-relative libraries, then this package's own modules, always as relative imports, farthest (`...`) before nearest (`.`).
- Public API = `<package_name>/api.py`, one re-exported name per line. Every public name has a docstring, or it is missing from the API docs.
- Test path mirrors source path, with the directory path as a file-name prefix: `<package_name>/a/b/c.py` maps to `tests/a/b/test_a_b_c.py`. Every tested folder has an `all.py` with `is_folder=True`.
- In test files, the subject under test is imported first. The `run_cov_test(...)` block at the bottom puts one argument per line.
- Before finishing a code change: `mise run format`, then `mise run lint`.
- In dataclass / pydantic / SQLAlchemy models, keep one field definition per line, fenced by `# fmt: off` / `# fmt: on`.
- Docs are Sphinx + furo + reST + nbsphinx notebooks, for the library's users only. In notebooks, Sphinx roles and directives go in raw cells with `raw_mimetype: text/restructuredtext`. Never edit `docs/source/api/` (generated by docfly). Hosted docs are optional: the latest on Cloudflare Pages behind Cloudflare Access (push `main` to `doc`), and one copy per released version on S3 (`deploy-versioned-doc`).
- Knowledge is written for agents: how to use the library goes in the `pypi-<package_name>` skill, how to maintain it in the `maintain-<package_name>-*` skills, never in a maintainer guide.
- Never read `$HOME/home_secret.toml` or `~/.aws/`, and never print the values of `GITHUB_TOKEN`, `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN`, or a CodeArtifact token.
- `mise run publish`, `remove-pkg-version`, `release`, `update-github-metadata`, `deploy-pages`, `deploy-versioned-doc`, `deploy-latest-doc`, the `setup-*` and `create-pages-project` tasks, and a push to `doc` change external services: run each one only after the user's yes, one step per yes.
- The changelog is `release-history.rst`. Never edit its `x.y.z (Backlog)` section.
